Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Student Assistant for the Global Supply Chain organization to be based at Ambu's HQ in Ballerup / Denmark.

Are you passionate about Supply Chain, Business Intelligence & Analytics? Do you thrive working in cross functional teams, supporting global projects and keen to learn more about the dynamics within a Global Supply Chain - Then Ambu might be your next career move.

As a Student Assistant, Global Supply Chain, you will play a key role in supporting Projects within Supply Chain and across the organisation. Furthermore, you will be a vital support within BI Data & Analytics. You will have various roles within the team and have a great opportunity to learn about the End2End Supply Chain.

You will join a highly skilled department, and you will report to Stefan Aksel Ranch Ghetz - Global Product Launch Manager, Global Supply Chain. You are expected to work from our HQ in Ballerup approximetly 15 hours/week.

Key responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Project Support across Global Supply Chain

• KPI / Dashboard Development / Support

• Ad Hoc Tasks

Suggested candidate profile

Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Are studying for a B.Sc or M.Sc within Supply Chain or similar fields

• Have experience working in a Supply Chain team before, however this is not required

• Have strong analytical skills

• Are proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint & Excel)

• Have skills in a BI Tool (Preferable Power Bi)

• Have strong communication skills in English

• Have a high energetic drive, motivation, and accountability

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Are you passionate about developing software and curious about how software powers modern factories? Would you like to work with cloud-based solutions for our factories in Denmark and the USA? Are you ready for an exciting and educational internship in an international high-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in our Manufacturing Software team, you will have a wide range of tasks in the entire software development process from specification, design, and implementation, through to review, testing, deployment, and monitoring. You will be part of a team, where you will be introduced to all facets of the work as a software developer.

In the position, you will work with a wide range of technologies, including:

• NET 5+ and .NET Framework

• Blazor, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML5

• Azure: App Services, Application Insights, Functions, Traffic Manager

• Databases: Cosmos DB, MS SQL Server, SQLite

• XUnit, AutoFixture, Moq, FluentAssertions

• Kubernetes Services

• GitHub Copilot

As our Intern, you will gain hands-on experience with the end-to-end software development process. Furthermore, you will be a trusted member of the team where you will be given responsibility for your own tasks, depending on your competencies and interests.

Meet your future team

As an intern, you will be part of our Manufacturing Software team, which is part of our Supply Chain Development department. The team consists of 8 developers and specialists who all work to develop Kamstrup’s manufacturing platform to ensure that our production runs optimally. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere, where you will work on equal footing with your colleagues while also being supported by your own mentor throughout the internship. Moreover, we have an open and inclusive culture where everyone is encouraged to bring their perspectives and ideas.

Did you know? We have a physicist and a board game enthusiast in the department.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a dedicated intern who is eager to put their theoretical knowledge into practice. You have a proactive approach to your work and are ready to contribute to the team’s success by bringing your ideas and perspectives into our professional discussions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying for a degree in Software Technology (ICT), Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field

• Are a quick learner and open to new technologies and working methods

• Have a strong sense of responsibility, both for your own projects and for shared projects

• Stay updated with the latest knowledge in your field and are passionate about turning it into sustainable solutions

• Are curious about how AI can be applied in our products as well as your daily work

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English. Proficiency in Danish is considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Manufacturing Software Development, Jørn Lylloff, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

Are you passionate about software development and eager to put your programming skills into play? Do you want to work in a development environment with experienced software developers, where we use Scrum to deliver value-adding solutions to our customers? Would you like to turn theory into practice in an international green-tech company?

Here is what your role entails

As a Software Intern, you will be involved in the full development lifecycle—from analysis and design to implementation, testing, and release, while working closely with experienced colleagues through sparring, Agile ceremonies, and code reviews. Throughout the internship, you will gain broad insight into our software development process and contribute to development, optimization, and hands‑on engineering tasks, including breaking down work items, detailed design, development, and testing.

Based on the MS .NET platform, you will work with a wide range of technologies and tools, including:

• C# (.net 4.7.2/core/10)

• Github Copilot

• WPF, WCF

• DBs (SQL, Mongo)

• Service Fabric

• Gitlab

• Powershell

As part of our commitment to modern software engineering, we also use AI-powered tools to support analysis, development, testing, documentation, and code quality.

This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies while actively contributing to real-world applications used across Kamstrup’s solutions, sharpening both your technical skills and understanding of secure, scalable software development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of Software & Analytics, Electricity department, consisting of experienced software developers and testers. In our teams we develop automated metering solutions, and we are very passionate about software design and programming. We work in agile teams, and you will be an integrated part of the developer team from day one. Collaboration is an essential part of our processes, and you can expect professional sparring, support, and knowledge sharing throughout your internship. Our development environment is constantly evolving, and we embrace curiosity, deep technical discussions, and ideas that challenge the way we work, whether we are exploring new technologies or refining existing processes.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a skilled and motivated student, who with their up-to-date knowledge wants to contribute to the continued development of our software.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying within Information and Communication Technology, Software Development, or another related field

• Have a great interest in high level software and bring up-to-date knowledge to the role

• Are quality-oriented, thorough with your tasks and your structural approach makes you good at maintaining a clear overview

• See teamwork and professional sparring as essential parts of your workday

It is a requirement that you are fluent in English both written and spoken.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Click on this link and apply now. The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Michael Weis, or Senior Manager, Troels Lund Rasmussen, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**We would like to invite you into a collaborative and inclusive environment where each member is a vital part of our success. Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. This can be felt all the way to our clients, who often talk about the enjoyable and effective partnerships they have with us.

“We’re proud of being a comprehensive solution for all things HR – from SuccessFactors and support to strategic HR advisory. And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Innovative Employee Central Implementation with ready2run®

**As a Senior Employee Central Consultant, you will lead large, international and complex implementations, taking ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design through deployment. ready2run® builds on our preconfigured starting solution, proven delivery framework and the way we shape implementation projects and customer offerings.

**Specifically, You Will

**

• Translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Help customers benefit from our ready2run® approach – both as a methodology and a mindset.

• Play an important part in strengthening our collective capability by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration across projects and helping junior consultants grow their confidence and expertise.

**Combine your strong technical expertise with your business understanding

**In this role, you will need a proactive focus on quality, detail and delivery, using your critical thinking skills and experience in resolving complex technical and functional issues in a timely and effective manner. Also, you possess a genuine desire to guide, challenge and develop colleagues, review work and share practical knowledge – and you can do so constructively in international teams. Moreover, with your strong communication skills, you engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted relationships with colleagues and clients alike.

Finally, we know nobody is perfect, but we imagine that you may:

• Have several years of hands-on experience configuring and implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.

• Have proven experience leading large, international and complex implementations, with ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design to deployment.

• Possess strong Employee Central solution knowledge, combined with the ability to analyze HR processes and translate business priorities into practical, scalable design.

• Be open to travelling and working on diverse projects, adapting to new challenges and environments.

• Be fluent in English (this is required), with additional Scandinavian languages being a plus.

• The role can be based in any Nordic country, with the expectation that you are within practical daily commuting distance of one of our local offices.

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. We proudly embrace people from all walks of life, regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or background. Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and create a richer, more creative work environment for everyone.

_At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 19,000 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

_We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ _billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

__With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

_NTT DATA Business Solutions: Make this the place where Y__ou grow.

Are you looking to expand your procurement, project management and analytical skills within a professional team focused on strategic procurement working with cost reductions, resilience, and sustainability? Do you want to make an impact in a global company serving millions with intimate health care needs?

We are offering a unique opportunity to join Coloplast Corporate Procurement department on a 15-20 hours/week-break basis. You will receive training and develop versatile and useful skills related to procurement, analysis, and project management, which will serve you in your future career. We are looking to fill two positions, one within Indirect Procurement (starting around August 1st) and one within Direct Procurement (starting around July 1st).

The Job

As part of the global Procurement organization, you will support the Indirect or Direct Procurement team with various activities aimed at enhancing the overall performance. You will have the opportunity to be part of the commercial procurement activities, but also actively working to improve our processes and systems. Your tasks will vary from administrative duties to support projects and daily category management within the Procurement organization and cross-functionally across the company.

You will collaborate closely with procurement colleagues, internal stakeholders, and in some cases suppliers. You will become an integrated part of our increasing focus on category management and procurement processes, contributing to strategic decisions that drive our commercial success.

Your qualifications

You are currently pursuing a master’s degree or are in the last year of your bachelor’s degree in finance, Procurement, Strategy, Supply Chain Management, or another relevant field and have preferably +2 years left of your studies. We are looking for individuals eager to learn and capable of managing their own time and deliverables. A team player who can work independently and has the desire to make a real difference.

Proficiency in spoken and written English is a requirement. Previous work experience in a related field is an advantage. You have an eye for detail, are structured, and possess a can-do attitude that, together with your ability to communicate effectively, enables you to deliver high-quality work and meet deadlines. You enjoy working in an intercultural environment, value different perspectives, and excel at building interpersonal relations.

You can look forward to engaging with professionals in a fun and informal atmosphere, developing and training the skills, methods, and know-how that will help you succeed in your future career. Here, we offer exciting opportunities to learn from the best – in an international business environment.

Interested?

If you have questions or are curious for more information, then please do not hesitate to contact Head of Category Management Indirect, Corporate Procurement, Frederik Hage on +45 4911 2782.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Do you want to strengthen cyber defence across IT, OT, and cloud environments? Are you motivated by protecting critical infrastructure that spans enterprise and industrial systems in an international green tech company? Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise while working hands-on with modern technologies?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Senior Cyber Security Specialist, you will drive the development and optimization of our SOC capabilities across IT, OT, and cloud environments. Working at the forefront of cyber defence, you will strengthen robust detection, response, and intelligence practices with a focus on efficiency and quality.

More specifically you will be:

• Supporting and enhancing the SOC team with scalable and repeatable processes

• Operationalizing workflows from monitoring and detection to incident response, threat hunting, and reporting

• Integrating and optimizing Microsoft Defender tools while unifying telemetry across EDR, NDR, SIEM, and ServiceNow

• Maintaining and operationalizing a threat intelligence program focused on critical infrastructure threats

• Collaborating with engineering to onboard logs and improving data quality for high fidelity detections

In this role, you can influence how cyber security operations are shaped across both enterprise and industrial environments, while working closely with skilled colleagues and stakeholders. Working alongside experienced colleagues and stakeholders, you will continuously expand your expertise through certifications, cross-domain collaboration, and tailored development opportunities.

**Meet your future team

**With a direct reference to our Chief Information Security Officer, you will become a part of Enterprise Cyber Security team consisting of 10 specialists who work together to protect the organization’s digital and physical assets across IT, OT, and cloud by detecting and responding to threats in real time. In the team, we value a collaborative and curious environment where we can share our knowledge. We foster a strong sense of colleagueship in the team, where we celebrate our colleagues’ achievements while encouraging and challenging each other to grow.

Did you know? We are a highly diverse team, with half of our members coming from international backgrounds.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Specialist who is motivated by strengthening cyber defence capabilities by applying your up-to-date knowledge of cyber security and threats targeting critical infrastructure. You achieve work-related goals by taking ownership of technical execution while combining deep technical insight with a structured and communicative approach.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a master’s degree in cyber security, computer science, or a related field

• Bring strong expertise in Microsoft Defender tools, Microsoft Sentinel or a similar SIEM, with hands on experience in SOAR, EDR, NDR, and SIEM including detection engineering and cyber threat assessments

• Have 10+ years of experience protecting IT, OT, and multi cloud environments with knowledge and or certifications such as CIS18, IEC62443, CISSP, or CISM

• Have experience with ServiceNow or similar system for case management and automation

• Have strong communication skills enabling executive reporting and cross functional collaboration

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Chief Information Security Officer, Kristian Kearton, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

• Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.

• Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.

• Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives

• Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.

• Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.

• Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.

• Represent QA/Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.

• Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions

• Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.

• Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

• Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**What We Value

**

• We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

**AI Agent Engineer

**Department: AI Delivery

Location: Copenhagen

Working model: Onsite

Reports to: AI Product Lead

Salary: Competitive

**About Autoflows

**Autoflows is an agentic after-sales platform for automotive retail.

We deploy AI agents across dealerships in Europe that handle customer conversations end to end across voice and messaging. Our agents identify the right moment to contact customers about service, MOT, warranty and other after-sales opportunities, then handle the conversation, book the appointment and write the outcome back into the dealership's systems.

Our platform connects with DMS, CRM and OEM data, turning after-sales work that traditionally sits in queues into work that runs itself.

We are now scaling across clients, markets and languages. That requires us to build a delivery capability that does not depend on one person knowing how everything works.

**The Role

**As an AI Agent Engineer, you will build, deploy, debug and continuously improve the conversational agents running across our clients.

**You Will Work Across The Full Lifecycle

****Build → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Debug → Improve

**You will start closely with the AI Product Lead and progressively take independent ownership of production agents and client implementations.

The role is not just about configuring agents. With time you will also help build the tooling and systems that make agents easier to deploy, operate and maintain at scale. Architectural decisions for the core agentic platform stay with the AI Product Lead; your platform involvement is about the tooling layer around agents, not the underlying architecture itself.

**What You'll Do

****Agent development

**

• Build and tune agents across voice, chat, SMS and WhatsApp

• Develop prompts, tools, workflows, guardrails and fallback paths

• Test agents against realistic customer scenarios

• Improve agent behavior using production data and conversation analysis

**Production & implementation

**

• Diagnose and fix live issues such as model failures, mispronunciations, failed tool calls, broken workflows and missing fallback paths

• Own new agent deployments as dealership clients onboard

• Adapt agents to different processes, languages and markets

• Work directly with clients when technical input is required

• Identify root causes rather than applying temporary fixes

**Integrations

**

• Work with DMS, CRM and other dealership systems

• Configure and troubleshoot integrations for customer data and workshop bookings

• Build reusable patterns for recurring integration requirements

**Agentic platform tooling

**

• We are building an agentic platform, not a collection of manually maintained bots. You will be encouraged to identify repetitive work and turn it into systems. This may include:

• Automated testing and evaluation

• Monitoring and regression detection

• Automated diagnosis of recurring failures

• Self-healing or automated recovery for well-understood failure modes

• Automated deployment and configuration

• Reusable agent components and workflows

• Agent-assisted documentation and operational tooling

• Systems that allow agents to improve from production feedback within defined quality and safety boundaries

**| "The principle is simple: if we solve the same problem repeatedly, we should build a system that solves it for us."

****Architecture & delivery

**

• Work with the AI Product Lead on complex architectural decisions

• Help determine when to use prompting, workflow logic, deterministic code, specialised agents or other approaches

• Document recurring solutions and contribute to the team's technical playbook

• Help establish standards that make future deployments faster and more reliable

**What We're Looking For

**This role sits between AI, technology and human behaviour. Technical ability is necessary, but technical ability alone is not enough. Our agents speak to real customers. You need to care about what the interaction feels like, not just whether the system technically works.

**Technical

**

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI APIs

• Strong understanding of prompting and model behaviour

• Experience debugging AI or software systems

• Ability to reason through ambiguous technical problems

• Comfort working without a finished specification

• Ability to learn unfamiliar platforms and systems quickly

**Human & social

**

• Strong social skills and clear communication

• Natural curiosity about how people think, speak and respond

• Ability to look at an interaction from the customer's perspective

• Good judgement about tone, context and conversational nuance

• Comfortable speaking directly with clients and asking the questions needed to understand a problem

• Able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people

• Open to feedback and willing to change your approach when evidence shows it is not working

• Interested in how language and culture affect conversational AI

**Builder mindset

**

• You investigate why something failed rather than simply fixing the visible symptom

• You notice repetitive work and look for ways to automate it

• You are comfortable experimenting, testing and iterating

• You think beyond the individual agent and look for ways to improve the underlying platform

**Strong plus

**

• Conversational AI or agent-building experience

• Voice AI, chatbots or workflow automation

• API and systems integration experience

• Experience with tools, function calling or agentic workflows

• Experience operating production AI systems

• Experience working across multiple languages

• Experience with CRM, ERP, DMS or similar business systems

• Automotive experience is not required.

**| "We would rather hire a technically capable builder who understands people than a technically exceptional engineer who does not."

****Success in the Role

**As you become fully productive, you should be able to:

• Independently diagnose and resolve most common agent failures

• Build and deploy agents with limited supervision

• Own production improvements from investigation through deployment

• Handle recurring integration problems

• Turn repeated manual work into reusable systems

• Improve the reliability and scalability of our agent platform

• Reduce the amount of hands-on implementation required from the AI Product Lead

**The Team

****You Will Work In a Small AI Delivery Team

**AI Product Lead - Owns product direction, architecture, priorities, technical standards and complex technical decisions

AI Agent Engineer - Owns agent development, implementation, production debugging and platform improvements

AI/ML Student - Supports testing, evaluation, research, data work, experimentation and implementation

Because the team is small, you will have significant ownership and direct exposure to the systems we are building.

**How To Apply

**Send your CV along with:

Show us something you built, broke or fixed. A link, repository, write-up, video or before/after example. We care more about how you approached the problem than how polished the result is.

Tell us why this problem interests you. Give us a short note explaining what attracts you to conversational AI, agentic systems and the challenge of making them work reliably in the real world.

Contact: Maz Katinas, AI Product Lead

**Job Description

****Would you like to make testing exciting? Are you passionate about shaping the way we work with software testing? Would you like to embark on a journey where we elevate our professional software testing standards to the next level?

**If so, we would be delighted to welcome you to BEUMER Group Software Solutions, a global family-owned company.

**Play a Central Role

**Every year, millions of passengers check in their baggage at one airport and collect it at another. This seamless experience relies on the quality of BEUMER Group software powering our complex baggage handling systems around the world. The same high standards of capacity and quality are reflected in our logistics solutions, where distribution centers sort and distribute thousands of parcels every day, quickly and efficiently across the globe.

**From Theory to Practice

**We are passionate about making tomorrow's world a little better, and we believe that high quality is achieved through mature, agile, and well-functioning processes.

Based on recognized testing principles, we have established a solid test process framework and are now fully engaged in implementing it across the organization. Therefore, we are looking for a Software Test Manager who can bridge the gap between theory and practice.

You will be a key player in ensuring that our processes are translated into concrete practices and implemented with a strong focus on delivering real value to both product teams and the System Test function for which we are responsible. In this role, you will act as a coach in our products' transformation journey while actively contributing to the establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our System Test suite, with a particular focus on automation.

We expect you to be hands-on and capable of stepping into the role of Test Manager within our software department, supporting teams in testing practices and demonstrating how effective testing contributes to the quality of our software products.

As we continue to gain experience, there will be an ongoing need to innovate and optimize our test process framework, including the adoption and use of AI. In other words, you will have ample opportunities to leverage your experience and expertise.

**What We Offer

**

• A collaborative culture built on trust, respect, and continuous improvement.

• An international work environment with colleagues and customers across the globe.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• Flexible working conditions and a healthy work-life balance.

• An informal and supportive working environment.

• The opportunity to influence quality practices across products and customer projects.

**Your New Team

**You will become part of a Software Test team that supports software product and project teams in testing practices and ensures that testing activities contribute to the quality of our software products and projects. Our team collaborates with a wide range of stakeholders across the organization.

**How You Will Spend Your Time

**As a Software Test Manager, you will primarily work with product development. For new system features, you will gradually take on a Test Architect role by participating in the early clarification and requirements phases.

For these features, you will also serve as the liaison to our highly skilled test team in Poland, which specializes in test automation.

Together with our other Test Manager, you will play a key role in planning and following up on the testing of our regular System Releases. You will also participate, to a limited extent, in manual exploratory testing and engage in discussions with development teams regarding identified defects.

More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

• Implementing the software testing strategy and define strong acceptance criteria.

• Participating in the early requirements clarification phase for new system features and providing test architecture expertise.

• Establishing software test management plans and follow-up activities for System Test initiatives.

• Planning, coordinating, and following up on software System Test activities.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of our System Test suite and processes.

• Establishing direction and driving the optimization and maturity of our testing processes.

• Strengthening and advancing the software testing discipline within the organization.

**What We Expect From You

**We expect you to have a background as an experienced Test Manager with strong personal impact and excellent communication skills. We also expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related field.

• Have an ISTQB Test Manager certification.

• Possess solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and quality management principles, applying a risk-based approach.

• Have experience with test management tools and defect tracking systems.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Thrive in a project-driven and technically complex environment.

• Take a structured, analytical, and proactive approach to your work.

• Are fluent in both Danish and English.

Interested?

If you are ready for a new test management challenge where you will take full ownership of deploying testing activities from theory to practice, we encourage you to apply.

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact **Global Head of Software Test Bert Petersen at 5371 1471.

**If you would like to play a committed role in our successful family-owned business, please apply online via the application link.

We look forward to meeting you.

**BEUMER Group

**_Conveying, loading, palletizing, packaging, sortation, and distribution: BEUMER Group is a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-tech intralogistics systems. Our employees stand out through their ability to deliver innovative solutions for our customers. They achieve this through deep industry knowledge and a passion for continuous learning and development.

_We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect, and a culture of trust that fosters stability and security for all employees. Our shared goal is to deliver outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

jobs.description:
Are you curious about how wireless communication systems power the smart technologies of tomorrow? Do you want to explore embedded software development on a Linux platform? Would you like to join an interdisciplinary R&D team where learning, collaboration, and innovation go hand in hand?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be part of our concentrator team, where we develop infrastructure products for collecting smart meter data. Your focus will be on embedded development for our Linux platform inside the concentrators, as well as contributing to our solution for automated monitoring the concentrators in operation at our customers.

You will be working with one or more of the following areas during the internship:

• Embedded software development in C++

• Linux platforms

• Statistical data analysis

• Data analysis and visualisation in Python

• Platforms for dashboarding, like Grafana or similar

• Performance analysis of wireless systems

You will gain experience with all phases of a typical development project at Kamstrup – from idea and evaluation to design and prototype implementation. This will give you valuable insight into the diverse and exciting role of a development engineer and help strengthen your future career. The specific content of the internship will be planned together according to your ambitions and competences. It is also possible to work with the topic described above as a semester project or M.Sc. thesis of 6–12 months duration.

Meet your future team

As Intern in our R&D department within wireless communication for smart metering, you will be an integral part of the interdisciplinary team, collaborating with engineers on various development tasks. Together we work to ensure that the data transmissions from smart meters are received and made available to our customers. You will become part of a strong work environment where you will experience a focus on freedom with responsibility and personal development.

Did you know? In addition to Linux experts the team has a homebrewer of beer, a pizza chef and a university lecturer. Moreover, every half year we break out from the development projects and embark on a one-week hackathon, where the entire team collaborates on small proof-of-concept projects.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who can contribute to the R&D department with their updated theoretical knowledge.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are pursuing a relevant engineering degree (e.g., Electrical Engineering or Information and Communication Technology) with an interest in mathematics, communication theory, and software development.

• Have a curious, thorough, and structured approach to solving complex challenges.

• Work independently with attention to detail and a strong desire to learn.

• Value collaboration and strive for continuous professional and personal growth.

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish will be an asset, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Manager, Rasmus Krigslund, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Turn complex study start-up into momentum—bringing sites from selection to activation with speed, structure, and confidence.

Who are we?

Sanos is a full circle clinical research and development organization with headquarter in Søborg, near Copenhagen, Denmark. The organization consists of around 200 employees, and is composed of six independent business units, each contributing to the comprehensive clinical research services provided. These units include NBCD, Sanos Clinic, Sanos Supply, Studies&Me, Blueskin, and Omicron.

All business units in Sanos are dedicated to providing first-class clinical research, aiming to keep improving and develop how we conduct innovative clinical trials for our clients and patients. We play a critical role in developing new medication and treatment options, and work diligently to bring new medication faster to the patients.

Your key roles and responsibilities

The Site Contract Manager is responsible for negotiating and executing clinical trial agreements and site budgets for our global Phase 1–3 trials, ensuring timely site activation and appropriate contractual and financial terms.

• Lead the end-to-end negotiation and execution of Clinical Trial Agreements, amendments and site budgets.

• Act as the main contact for contractual and budget discussions with sites, institutions and sponsors.

• Drive contracts to signature within agreed timelines and escalate legal, operational or financial issues as needed.

• Maintain contract trackers and provide clear status updates to study teams and management.

• Coordinate with Clinical Operations, Clinical Proposals and Finance, including handover for site payment setup in Veeva.

• Support continuous improvement of contracting templates, processes and tools.

Travel: Little, if any, travel is expected.

Work location: Søborg, Denmark.

Desired skills and experience

• Hands-on site contracting experience from a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or clinical research environment.

• Strong experience negotiating Clinical Trial Agreements and site budgets, preferably across multiple countries.

• Good understanding of study start-up and the link between contracting, site activation and study delivery.

• Ability to identify contractual, commercial and operational risks and escalate appropriately.

• Experience with trackers and reporting tools; knowledge of Veeva site payment setup is an advantage.

• Strong written and spoken English.

Success criteria includes

• Driving contract execution within agreed project timelines

• Support achieving First Site Activated as well as Last Site Activated

• Contribute to reduction of contracting cycles and cycle times, and ensure sustainable and compliant budget agreements.

Personal profile

• A confident and pragmatic negotiator with strong attention to detail.

• Structured and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines.

• Collaborative, commercially aware and comfortable working independently in an international environment

Are we a perfect cultural fit?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying ‘Trust in you – in your development and impact´.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within Sanos, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very offset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within Sanos culture and the Sanos Way of Leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

• Take on - Responsibility is given, and we inspire you to take it.

• Try out - Explore diverse tasks and grow professionally.

• Team up - We don’t just work together; we thrive together.

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of Sanos Group people here.

Ready to make a real impact?

We look forward to hearing from you, so please send your application through the “apply” link.

We will be performing interviews ongoing in the process and look to fill the position as soon as possible. We close the position when we find the right candidate.

For further information about the role contact, Sara Daugaard Popik at sdp@sanos.com.

If you proceed in the recruitment process, you will go through a few additional steps where both you and we will assess whether this position is the right match for both parties. As part of the recruitment process, we use assessments to ensure the optimal match and the best foundation for future collaboration.

Sanos is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives leads to better decision-making and innovation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

We value your data and take care to protect it. Please see more information regarding privacy for job applicants here.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight
jobs.description:
Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

The job

As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

Joining the team

Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

Your qualifications

You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

• excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate confidently and effectively in English

• confidence in presenting to larger audiences, for example at customer visits, conferences or user forums

• an independent, structured work style with the ability to prioritise your own work and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you are not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations – you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering ensures you are always well taken care of. And whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,200 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Hans Jørgen Bohlbro, Vice President, Product Management.

jobs.occupation: Senior Incident Response Security Consultant, Mandiant, Google Cloud (English)
jobs.description:
Google welcomes people with disabilities.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

**Remote locations: Italy; Denmark.****Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience working end-to-end incident response investigations, analysis, or containment actions.

• 5 years of investigative experience with network forensics, malware triage analysis, cloud forensics, or disk and memory forensics.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently to work with internal partners and customer teams.

• Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certifications in cloud platforms.

• Experience in security competitions, Capture the Flags (CTFs) or testing platforms such as Hack the Box, TryHackMe, Overthewire, etc.

• Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, legal counsel, and internal and external clients.

• Excellent time and project management skills.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Incident Response Security Consultant, you will provide industry-leading incident response, assessment, transformation, managed detection and response, and training services with in-depth tactical support. You will help organizations effectively detect and respond to threats and reduce the overall impact of business risk before, during, and after an incident. You will be able to resolve security incidents quickly, effectively and at scale with complete incident response including investigation, containment, remediation, and crisis management. In this role, you will work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.960000 - kr.980000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Italy: €88000 - €90000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Collaborate with internal and customer teams to investigate and contain incidents.

• Recognize and codify attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) and indicators of compromise (IOCs) that can be applied to current and future investigations.

• Conduct host forensics, network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of incident response investigations.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US  As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, in the Platform Automation department. Here, you will join a cross-functional agile team based in Copenhagen, Kyiv and Manila. Your team is responsible for building a continuous delivery pipeline for our core products in Cloud and you will be working in close co-operation with your colleagues across different locations. You will provide input into our technical vision and direction. We value good craftsmanship.

Your team owns the SimCorp Dimension (SCD) Delivery Pipeline. A platform for end-to-end automation that enables the development, testing, and release of consistent product versions at scale. This is your opportunity to make a tangible impact on how SimCorp delivers software to clients worldwide, working on tooling and infrastructure that directly supports hundreds of engineers across the organisation.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Design, develop, test, and continuously enhance our applications and pipelines, driving forward both reliability and capability.

• Collaborate closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owner, System Architect, and other stakeholders to translate product vision into technical requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.

• Mentor and guide junior and mid-level colleagues, raising the technical bar across the team.

• Apply your expertise across all stages of the development lifecycle from reviewing user stories and design to code reviews and automated testing.

• Ensure code quality and technical excellence. Research tools and frameworks to enable future innovation.

• Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, and apply this knowledge to improve our solutions and practices.

**What We Value

**

• Experience working in an international setting with people from many different cultures

• Constructive and positive mindset: you help foster an environment where the team can collaborate openly and do its best work

• You care about your team and care about having an enjoyable working environment

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (speaking and writing)

**Technical Skills That We Are Looking For

**

• Experience working with software development using one or more modern programming languages (We mostly use C#).

• Experience implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

• Build Automation: Experience with build automation tools and practices.

• Design Patterns: Knowledge of common design patterns and best practices in software architecture.

• Testing: Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development (TDD).

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong understanding of IaC principles and practices.

• Our Tech stack :

• Git: Proficient in using Git for source control, including branching and merging strategies.

• TeamCity: Proficiency in setting up, managing, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using TeamCity or another similar tool.

• Azure: Experience working with Azure services, including computing, storage, networking, and databases.

• PowerShell: Experience in scripting with PowerShell for automation and administration tasks.

• Cake: Proficiency in using Cake (C# Make) for build automation.

• Kotlin: Competence in Kotlin for application development, particularly for backend services.

• Claude and Copilot

**Soft Skills

**

• Experience in guiding junior developers and providing technical guidance.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effectively interacting with team members, stakeholders, and clients.

• Ability to clearly convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to identify issues, take ownership and develop effective solutions.

• Experience working in agile development environments.

DESIRABLE

• Security Awareness - Understanding of security best practices and how to implement them in software development.

• Performance Optimization - Skills in optimizing code and systems for performance and scalability.

• Documentation - Ability to create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation.

• Desirable technology experience: Kubernetes, Docker, Elastic Search, C#, Terraform/Bicep.

**Benefits

**We offer a competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension — essentials for any work agreement. But at SimCorp, we believe in offering more. In addition to a traditional benefits package, we provide excellent work-life balance through flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model.

We also offer IP sprints — three weeks per quarter dedicated to mastering your skills and contributing innovative ideas to company development.

There is never just one path — we take an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continuously. Please note that only applications submitted through our system will be considered.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you're interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role.

The approximate time to review your CV is three weeks.

We are committed to continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we will ask for your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

jobs.occupation: Electronics/Firmware Engineer for Medical Laser Company
jobs.description:
Reporting to the R&D manager, your tasks will be highly diversified and will include:

• Define, describe, and design electronics of new and existing products

• Identify and integrate electronic modules into systems

• Analyze malfunctions or handle part replacements or re-designs

• Verify designs and design integrations to raise product quality

• Be an active part of the R&D team on development projects and support existing products

• Write and review Software

• Prepare required documents due to regulatory and quality measurement required for medical devices

Candidate profile:

Your qualifications should include a technical background with a preference for system analysis or technical exposure, preferably including:

• An engineering degree or equivalent work experience required

• Experienced with electronics circuit and PCB layout design

• Experienced with firmware development in C/C++

• Handling the PCB and electronics supply chain (ordering, BOM’s, documentation)

• Experienced with Design for Electrical Safety and EMC testing

• Excellent technical oral and written skills in English

Furthermore, the ideal candidate would have experience with

• IEC 60601 and ISO 13485 standards

• Digital communication standards such as USB, CAN Bus, SPI, …

• Lasers and Optics ERP systems (NAV)

• User interfaces

• Making test setups for HW and SW verification and validation

• Experience with Altium Designer

You will be part of a small, dedicated team. Therefore, we expect you to be an independent and flexible co-worker with the ability to overview multiple tasks, while keeping up quality, structure and good teamwork. In return, you are offered flexible working hours and a strong influence on how your job is carried out.
